records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our net sales of $226.3 million for the first quarter of fiscal 2022 increased 7.6% from our net sales of $210.3 million for the first quarter of fiscal 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Sales volume, measured as pounds sold to customers, increased 14.0% compared to the first quarter of fiscal 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The total value of inventories on hand at the end of the first quarter of fiscal 2022 increased $2.2 million, or 1.5%, in comparison to the total value of inventories on hand at the end of the first quarter of fiscal 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total operating expenses for the first quarter of fiscal 2022 increased $4.0 million, or 19.6%, compared to the first quarter of fiscal 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Due to the factors discussed above, income from operations increased to $27.3 million, or 12.1% of net sales, for the first quarter of fiscal 2022 from $18.9 million, or 9.0% of net sales, for the first quarter of fiscal 2021.
